alt: 孩子踮腳偷偷靠近餅乾罐，左右張望，一手掀開蓋子，另一手把餅乾藏在背後。
scene_prompt: In a home kitchen a child tiptoes furtively behind a doorway toward a biscuit jar, shoulders hunched, eyes glancing left and right to see whether anyone notices. One hand quietly lifts the lid while the other hides a biscuit behind their back. A parent is visible far away facing the sink, unaware. Clearly sneaky concealed action, no ghost or supernatural motif.
